nodes.name: AcquisitionFrameCount
nodes.description: Number of frames to acquire for each Acquisition Start trigger.

nodes.name: AcquisitionFrameRateAbs
nodes.description: Acquisition frame rate of the camera in frames per second.

nodes.name: AcquisitionFrameRateEnable
nodes.description: Enables setting the camera's acquisition frame rate to a specified value.

nodes.name: AcquisitionMode
nodes.description: Sets the image acquisition mode.

nodes.name: AcquisitionStart
nodes.description: Starts the acquisition of images. If the camera is configured for single frame acquisition, it will start the acquisition of one frame. If the camera is configured for continuous frame acquisition, it will start the continuous acquisition of frames.

nodes.name: AcquisitionStartEventData
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring Acquisition Start events. An Acquisition Start event is raised whenever the Acquisition Start trigger is activated.

nodes.name: AcquisitionStartEventStreamChannelIndex
nodes.display_name: Acquisition Start Event Stream Channel Index
nodes.description: Stream channel index of the Acquisition Start event.

nodes.name: AcquisitionStartEventTimestamp
nodes.description: Timestamp of the Acquisition Start event.

nodes.name: AcquisitionStartOvertriggerEventData
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring Acquisition Start Overtrigger events.

nodes.name: AcquisitionStartOvertriggerEventStreamChannelIndex
nodes.display_name: Acquisition Start Overtrigger Event Stream Channel Index
nodes.description: Stream channel index of the Acquisition Start Overtrigger event.

nodes.name: AcquisitionStartOvertriggerEventTimestamp
nodes.description: Timestamp of the Acquisition Start Overtrigger event.

nodes.name: AcquisitionStartWaitEventData
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring Acquisition Start Wait events.

nodes.name: AcquisitionStartWaitEventStreamChannelIndex
nodes.display_name: Acquisition Start Wait Event Stream Channel Index
nodes.description: Stream channel index of the Acquisition Start Wait event.

nodes.name: AcquisitionStartWaitEventTimestamp
nodes.description: Timestamp of the Acquisition Start Wait event.

nodes.name: AcquisitionStatus
nodes.description: Indicates whether the camera is waiting for trigger signals. You should only use this feature if the camera is configured for software triggering. If the camera is configured for hardware triggering, monitor the camera's Trigger Wait signals instead.

nodes.name: AcquisitionStatusSelector
nodes.description: Sets the signal whose status you want to check. Its status can be checked by reading the Acquisition Status parameter value.

nodes.name: AcquisitionStop
nodes.description: Stops the acquisition of images if a continuous image acquisition is in progress.

nodes.name: AcquisitionTrigger
nodes.description: Contains parameters for controlling image acquisition and triggering.

nodes.name: ActionCommandCount
nodes.description: Number of separate action signals supported by the camera. Determines how many action signals the camera can handle in parallel, i.e., how many different action commands can be configured on the camera.

nodes.name: ActionControl
nodes.description: Contains parameters for controlling the Action Command feature which is used for triggering an action on multiple cameras at roughly the same time.

nodes.name: ActionDeviceKey
nodes.description: Device key used to authorize the execution of an action command. If the action device key in the camera and the action device key in the protocol message are identical, the camera will execute the corresponding action.

nodes.name: ActionGroupKey
nodes.description: Group key used to define a group of cameras on which action commands can be executed.

nodes.name: ActionGroupMask
nodes.description: Group mask used to filter out a sub-group of cameras belonging to a group of cameras. The cameras belonging to a sub-group execute an action at the same time. The filtering is done using a logical bitwise AND operation on the group mask number of the action command and the group mask number of a camera. If both binary numbers have at least one common bit set to 1 (i.e., the result of the AND operation is non-zero), the corresponding camera belongs to the sub-group.

nodes.name: ActionLateEventData
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring Action Late events. An Action Late event is raised when a scheduled action command with a timestamp in the past is received.

nodes.name: ActionLateEventStreamChannelIndex
nodes.display_name: Action Late Event Stream Channel Index
nodes.description: Stream channel index of the Action Late event. An Action Late event is raised when a scheduled action command with a timestamp in the past is received.

nodes.name: ActionLateEventTimestamp
nodes.description: Timestamp of the Action Late event. An Action Late event is raised when a scheduled action command with a timestamp in the past is received.

nodes.name: ActionSelector
nodes.description: Action command to be configured.

nodes.name: AnalogControls
nodes.description: Contains parameters for controlling the analog characteristics of the image data.

nodes.name: AOI
nodes.description: Contains parameters for specifying the size and position of the area of interest.

nodes.name: AutoExposureTimeAbsLowerLimit
nodes.description: Lower limit of the Exposure Time parameter when the Exposure Auto auto function is active.

nodes.name: AutoExposureTimeAbsUpperLimit
nodes.description: Upper limit of the Exposure Time parameter when the Exposure Auto auto function is active.

nodes.name: AutoExposureTimeLowerLimitRaw
nodes.description: Lower limit of the Exposure Time parameter when the Exposure Auto auto function is active (raw value).

nodes.name: AutoExposureTimeUpperLimitRaw
nodes.description: Upper limit of the Exposure Time parameter when the Exposure Auto auto function is active (raw value).

nodes.name: AutoFunctionAOIHeight
nodes.description: Height of the auto function AOI (in pixels).

nodes.name: AutoFunctionAOIOffsetX
nodes.description: Horizontal offset of the auto function AOI from the left side of the sensor (in pixels).

nodes.name: AutoFunctionAOIOffsetY
nodes.description: Vertical offset of the auto function AOI from the top of the sensor (in pixels).

nodes.name: AutoFunctionAOIs
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring auto function AOIs (areas of interest).

nodes.name: AutoFunctionAOISelector
nodes.description: Sets which auto function AOI can be configured.

nodes.name: AutoFunctionAOIUsageIntensity
nodes.description: Assigns the Gain Auto and the Exposure Auto auto functions to the currently selected auto function AOI. For this parameter, Gain Auto and Exposure Auto are considered as a single auto function named 'Intensity'.

nodes.name: AutoFunctionAOIUsageWhiteBalance
nodes.description: Assigns the Balance White Auto auto function to the currently selected auto function AOI.

nodes.name: AutoFunctionAOIWidth
nodes.description: Width of the auto function AOI (in pixels).

nodes.name: AutoFunctionProfile
nodes.description: Sets how gain and exposure time will be balanced when the camera is making automatic adjustments.

nodes.name: AutoFunctions
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring auto functions.

nodes.name: AutoGainRawLowerLimit
nodes.description: Lower limit of the Gain parameter when the Gain Auto auto function is active (raw value).

nodes.name: AutoGainRawUpperLimit
nodes.description: Upper limit of the Gain parameter when the Gain Auto auto function is active (raw value).

nodes.name: AutoTargetValue
nodes.description: Target brightness for the Gain Auto and the Exposure Auto auto functions.

nodes.name: BalanceRatioAbs
nodes.description: Balance Ratio value to be applied to the currently selected channel.

nodes.name: BalanceRatioRaw
nodes.description: Balance Ratio value to be applied to the currently selected channel (raw value).

nodes.name: BalanceRatioSelector
nodes.description: Sets which color channel can be adjusted when performing manual white balance. All changes to the Balance Ratio parameter will be applied to the selected color channel.

nodes.name: BalanceWhiteAdjustmentDampingAbs
nodes.description: Balance White adjustment damping factor to be applied. This controls the speed with which the camera adjusts colors when the Balance White Auto auto function is enabled. This can be useful, for example, when objects move into the camera's field of view and the light conditions are changing gradually due to the moving objects.

nodes.name: BalanceWhiteAdjustmentDampingRaw
nodes.description: Balance White adjustment damping factor to be applied (raw value). This controls the speed with which the camera adjusts colors when the Balance White Auto auto function is enabled. This can be useful, for example, when objects move into the camera's field of view and the light conditions are changing gradually due to the moving objects.

nodes.name: BalanceWhiteAuto
nodes.description: Sets the operation mode of the Balance White Auto auto function.

nodes.name: BalanceWhiteReset
nodes.description: Resets all white balance adjustments.

nodes.name: BinningHorizontal
nodes.description: Number of adjacent horizontal pixels to be summed. Their charges will be summed and reported out of the camera as a single pixel.

nodes.name: BinningHorizontalMode
nodes.description: Sets the binning mode for horizontal binning.

nodes.name: BinningModeHorizontal
nodes.description: Sets the binning mode for horizontal binning.

nodes.name: BinningModeVertical
nodes.description: Sets the binning mode for vertical binning.

nodes.name: BinningVertical
nodes.description: Number of adjacent vertical pixels to be summed. Their charges will be summed and reported out of the camera as a single pixel.

nodes.name: BinningVerticalMode
nodes.description: Sets the binning mode for vertical binning.

nodes.name: BlackLevelRaw
nodes.description: Black level value to be applied to the currently selected sensor tap (raw value).

nodes.name: BlackLevelSelector
nodes.description: Sets which sensor tap can be configured. All changes to the Black Level parameter will be applied to the selected sensor tap.

nodes.name: BLCSerialFramingError
nodes.description: A serial framing error occurred on reception.

nodes.name: BLCSerialParityError
nodes.description: A serial parity error occurred on reception.

nodes.name: BLCSerialPortBaudRate
nodes.description: Reports the baud rate of the serial communication module.

nodes.name: BLCSerialPortClearErrors
nodes.description: Clears the error flags of the serial communication module.

nodes.name: BLCSerialPortControl
nodes.description: Contains parameters to control serial communication with external devices.

nodes.name: BLCSerialPortParity
nodes.description: Reports the parity bit configuration of the serial communication module.

nodes.name: BLCSerialPortReceiveCmd
nodes.description: Reads and removes the front byte value from the serial communication receive queue.

nodes.name: BLCSerialPortReceiveValue
nodes.description: Last byte value read from the serial communication receive queue.

nodes.name: BLCSerialPortSource
nodes.description: Sets the signal source for the serial communication module.

nodes.name: BLCSerialPortStopBits
nodes.description: Reports the number of stop bits used by the serial communication module.

nodes.name: BLCSerialPortTransmitCmd
nodes.description: Writes the current byte value to the transmit queue.

nodes.name: BLCSerialPortTransmitValue
nodes.description: Byte value to be written to the transmit queue.

nodes.name: BLCSerialReceiveQueueStatus
nodes.description: Reports the status of the serial communication receive queue.

nodes.name: BLCSerialTransmitQueueStatus
nodes.description: Reports the status of the serial communication transmit queue.

nodes.name: BslBrightness
nodes.description: Adjusting the brightness lightens or darkens the entire image.

nodes.name: BslBrightnessRaw
nodes.description: Adjusting the brightness lightens or darkens the entire image.

nodes.name: BslContrast
nodes.description: Adjusting the contrast increases the difference between light and dark areas in the image.

nodes.name: BslContrastMode
nodes.description: Sets the contrast mode.

nodes.name: BslContrastRaw
nodes.description: Adjusting the contrast increases the difference between light and dark areas in the image.

nodes.name: BslHue
nodes.description: Adjusting the hue shifts the colors of the image. This can be useful, e.g., to correct minor color shifts or to create false-color images.

nodes.name: BslHueRaw
nodes.description: Adjusting the hue shifts the colors of the image. This can be useful, e.g., to correct minor color shifts or to create false-color images.

nodes.name: BslLightControl
nodes.description: Contains parameters for the light control features.

nodes.name: BslLightControlEnumerateDevices
nodes.description: Searches for light devices connected to your camera.

nodes.name: BslLightControlErrorStatus
nodes.description: Indicates whether any of the light devices are currently experiencing problems.

nodes.name: BslLightControlMode
nodes.description: Enables/disables the light control features.

nodes.name: BslLightControlSource
nodes.description: Sets which line is used to control the light features.

nodes.name: BslLightControlStatus
nodes.description: Indicates the current state of the light control mode.

nodes.name: BslLightControlTriggerMode
nodes.description: Sets which signal is used to trigger the light in strobe mode. The default setting is Exposure Active.

nodes.name: BslLightDeviceBrightness
nodes.description: Brightness of the light in percent of total brightness available. Setting this parameter to 100 % means that the light device draws the maximum current as specified by the the Light Device Max Current parameter.

nodes.name: BslLightDeviceBrightnessRaw
nodes.description: Brightness of the light in percent of total brightness available (raw value). Setting this parameter to 100 % means that the light device draws the maximum current as specified by the the Light Device Max Current parameter.

nodes.name: BslLightDeviceChangeID
nodes.description: Changes the ID of the currently selected light device. The new ID will be assigned immediately.

nodes.name: BslLightDeviceClearLastError
nodes.description: Clears the last light device error.

nodes.name: BslLightDeviceControlMode
nodes.description: Sets how the light device is controlled.

nodes.name: BslLightDeviceFirmwareVersion
nodes.description: Version of the light device's firmware.

nodes.name: BslLightDeviceLastError
nodes.description: Indicates the last light device error.

nodes.name: BslLightDeviceMaxCurrent
nodes.description: Maximum current that the light device is going to use. The value should not exceed the power rating of the device. To change the setting, the Light Device Operation Mode parameter must be set to Off.

nodes.name: BslLightDeviceMaxCurrentRaw
nodes.description: Maximum current that the light device is going to use (raw value). The value should not exceed the power rating of the device. To change the setting, the Light Device Operation Mode parameter must be set to Off.

nodes.name: BslLightDeviceModelName
nodes.description: Name of the light device model.

nodes.name: BslLightDeviceOperationMode
nodes.description: Sets the operation mode of the light device.

nodes.name: BslLightDeviceOverdriveLimit
nodes.description: Maximum current to be used when operating the light device in overdrive. This parameter value is relative to the value of the Light Device Max Current parameter.

nodes.name: BslLightDeviceOverdriveLimitRaw
nodes.description: Maximum current to be used when operating the light device in overdrive (raw value). This parameter value is relative to the value of the Light Device Max Current parameter.

nodes.name: BslLightDeviceSelector
nodes.description: Sets which light device can be configured. To populate the list, use the Light Control Enumerate Devices command first. All subsequent parameter changes in this category will be applied to the device selected here.

nodes.name: BslLightDeviceStrobeDuration
nodes.description: Duration of the individual strobe pulses. The maximum value is 655 350 microseconds.

nodes.name: BslLightDeviceStrobeDurationRaw
nodes.description: Duration of the individual strobe pulses (raw value). The maximum value is 655 350 microseconds.

nodes.name: BslLightDeviceStrobeMode
nodes.description: Sets the strobe mode of the light device.

nodes.name: BslSaturation
nodes.description: Adjusting the saturation changes the colorfulness (intensity) of the colors. A higher saturation, for example, makes colors easier to distinguish.

nodes.name: BslSaturationRaw
nodes.description: Adjusting the saturation changes the colorfulness (intensity) of the colors. A higher saturation, for example, makes colors easier to distinguish.

nodes.name: CenterX
nodes.description: Centers the image horizontally.

nodes.name: CenterY
nodes.description: Centers the image vertically.

nodes.name: ChunkData
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring chunk data. Data chunks can be appended to the image data to supply additional information about the image.

nodes.name: ChunkDataStreams
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring chunk data. Data chunks can be appended to the image data to supply additional information about the image.

nodes.name: ChunkDynamicRangeMax
nodes.description: Maximum possible pixel value in the acquired image.

nodes.name: ChunkDynamicRangeMin
nodes.description: Minimum possible pixel value in the acquired image.

nodes.name: ChunkEnable
nodes.description: Includes the currently selected chunk in the payload data.

nodes.name: ChunkExposureTime
nodes.description: Exposure time used to acquire the image.

nodes.name: ChunkFramecounter
nodes.description: Value of the Frame counter when the image was acquired.

nodes.name: ChunkFramesPerTriggerCounter
nodes.description: Value of the Frames per Trigger counter when the image was acquired.

nodes.name: ChunkFrameTriggerCounter
nodes.description: Value of the Frame Trigger counter when the image was acquired.

nodes.name: ChunkFrameTriggerIgnoredCounter
nodes.description: Value of the Frame Trigger Ignored counter when the image was acquired.

nodes.name: ChunkGainAll
nodes.description: Gain All value of the acquired image.

nodes.name: ChunkHeight
nodes.description: AOI height of the acquired image.

nodes.name: ChunkInputStatusAtLineTriggerBitsPerLine
nodes.description: Number of bits per line used for the Input Status At Line Trigger parameter.

nodes.name: ChunkInputStatusAtLineTriggerIndex
nodes.description: Index number used for the Input Status At Line Trigger parameter. The index number can be used to get the state of the camera's input lines when a specific line was acquired. For example, if you want to know the state of the camera's input lines when line 30 was acquired, set the index to 30, then retrieve the value of Status Index parameter.

nodes.name: ChunkInputStatusAtLineTriggerValue
nodes.description: Value indicating the status of the camera's input lines when a specific line was acquired. The information is stored in a 4-bit value (bit 0 = input line 1 state, bit 1 = input line 2 state etc.). For more information, see the Status Index parameter documentation.

nodes.name: ChunkLineStatusAll
nodes.description: Bit field that indicates the status of all of the camera's input and output lines when the image was acquired.

nodes.name: ChunkLineTriggerCounter
nodes.description: Value of the Line Trigger counter when the image was acquired.

nodes.name: ChunkLineTriggerEndToEndCounter
nodes.display_name: Line Trigger End To End Counter
nodes.description: Value of the Line Trigger End to End counter when the image was acquired.

nodes.name: ChunkLineTriggerIgnoredCounter
nodes.description: Value of the Line Trigger Ignored counter when the image was acquired.

nodes.name: ChunkModeActive
nodes.description: Enables the chunk mode.

nodes.name: ChunkOffsetX
nodes.description: X offset of the AOI of the acquired image.

nodes.name: ChunkOffsetY
nodes.description: Y offset of the AOI of the acquired image.

nodes.name: ChunkPayloadCRC16
nodes.description: CRC checksum of the acquired image. The checksum is calculated using all of the image data and all of the appended chunks except for the checksum itself.

nodes.name: ChunkPixelFormat
nodes.description: Indicates the pixel format of the acquired image.

nodes.name: ChunkSelector
nodes.description: Sets which chunk can be enabled. The chunk can be enabled using the Chunk Enable parameter.

nodes.name: ChunkSequenceSetIndex
nodes.description: Sequence set index number related to the acquired image.

nodes.name: ChunkShaftEncoderCounter
nodes.description: Value of the Shaft Encoder counter when the image was acquired.

nodes.name: ChunkStride
nodes.description: Number of bytes of data between the beginning of one line in the acquired image and the beginning of the next line in the acquired image.

nodes.name: ChunkTimestamp
nodes.description: Value of the timestamp when the image was acquired.

nodes.name: ChunkTriggerinputcounter
nodes.description: Value of the Trigger Input counter when the image was acquired.

nodes.name: ChunkVirtLineStatusAll
nodes.description: Status of all of the camera's virtual input and output lines when the image was acquired.

nodes.name: ChunkWidth
nodes.description: Width of the AOI of the acquired image.

nodes.name: ClearLastError
nodes.description: Clears the last error. If a previous error exists, the previous error can still be retrieved.

nodes.name: ColorAdjustmentEnable
nodes.description: Enables color adjustment.

nodes.name: ColorAdjustmentHue
nodes.description: Hue adjustment value to be applied to the currently selected color channel.

nodes.name: ColorAdjustmentHueRaw
nodes.description: Hue adjustment value to be applied to the currently selected color channel (raw value).

nodes.name: ColorAdjustmentReset
nodes.description: Allows you to restore the color adjustment settings that were in force before the settings were last changed.

nodes.name: ColorAdjustmentSaturation
nodes.description: Saturation adjustment value  to be applied to the currently selected color channel.

nodes.name: ColorAdjustmentSaturationRaw
nodes.description: Saturation adjustment value to be applied to the currently selected color channel (raw value).

nodes.name: ColorAdjustmentSelector
nodes.description: Sets which color in your images will be adjusted.

nodes.name: ColorTransformationMatrixFactor
nodes.description: Extent to which the color matrix influences the color values. If set to 0, the matrix is effectively disabled.

nodes.name: ColorTransformationMatrixFactorRaw
nodes.description: Extent to which the color matrix influences the color values (raw value). If set to 0, the matrix is effectively disabled.

nodes.name: ColorTransformationSelector
nodes.description: Sets which type of color transformation will be performed.

nodes.name: ColorTransformationValue
nodes.description: Transformation value for the selected element in the color transformation matrix.

nodes.name: ColorTransformationValueRaw
nodes.description: Transformation value for the selected element in the color transformation matrix (raw value).

nodes.name: ColorTransformationValueSelector
nodes.description: Sets which element will be entered in the color transformation matrix. Depending on the camera model, some elements in the color transformation matrix may be preset and can't be changed.

nodes.name: CounterEventSource
nodes.description: Sets which event that increases the currently selected counter.

nodes.name: CounterReset
nodes.description: Immediately resets the selected counter. The counter starts counting again immediately after the reset.

nodes.name: CounterResetSource
nodes.description: Sets which source signal will reset the currently selected counter.

nodes.name: CounterSelector
nodes.description: Sets which counter can be configured. All changes to the counter settings will be applied to the selected counter.

nodes.name: CriticalTemperature
nodes.description: Indicates whether the critical temperature has been reached.

nodes.name: CriticalTemperatureEventData
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring Critical Temperature events.

nodes.name: CriticalTemperatureEventStreamChannelIndex
nodes.display_name: Critical Temperature Event Stream Channel Index
nodes.description: Stream channel index of the Critical Temperature event.

nodes.name: CriticalTemperatureEventTimestamp
nodes.description: Timestamp of the Critical Temperature event.

nodes.name: DecimationHorizontal
nodes.description: Horizontal decimation factor. This specifies the extent of horizontal sub-sampling of the acquired frame, i.e., it defines how many pixel columns are left out of transmission. This has the net effect of reducing the horizontal resolution (width) of the image by the specified decimation factor. A value of 1 means that the camera performs no horizontal decimation.

nodes.name: DecimationVertical
nodes.description: Vertical decimation factor. This specifies the extent of vertical sub-sampling of the acquired frame, i.e., it defines how many rows are left out of transmission. This has the net effect of reducing the vertical resolution (height) of the image by the specified decimation factor. A value of 1 means that the camera performs no vertical decimation.

nodes.name: DefaultSetSelector
nodes.description: Sets which factory set that will be the default startup set.

nodes.name: DemosaicingMode
nodes.description: Sets the demosaicing mode.

nodes.name: DeviceFirmwareVersion
nodes.description: Version of the camera's firmware.

nodes.name: DeviceID

nodes.name: DeviceRegistersStreamingEnd

nodes.name: DeviceRegistersStreamingStart

nodes.name: DeviceReset

nodes.name: DeviceScanType

nodes.name: DigitalShift
nodes.description: Digital shift allows you to multiply the pixel values in an image. This increases the brightness of the image. If the parameter is set to zero, digital shift is disabled.

nodes.name: EnableBurstAcquisition
nodes.description: Enables Burst Acquisition. If enabled, the maximum frame rate only depends on the sensor timing and the timing of the trigger sequence. The image transfer rate out of the camera has no influence on the frame rate.

nodes.description: Contains parameters for using expert features.

nodes.description: Timestamp of the Frame Timeout event.

nodes.name: GainAuto
nodes.description: Sets the operation mode of the Gain Auto auto function. The Gain Auto auto function automatically adjusts the gain within set limits until a target brightness value has been reached.

nodes.name: GainRaw
nodes.description: Value of the currently selected gain (raw value).

nodes.name: GainSelector
nodes.description: Sets the gain type to be adjusted. All changes to the Gain parameter will be applied to the selected gain type.

nodes.name: Gamma
nodes.description: Gamma correction to be applied. Gamma correction allows you to optimize the brightness of acquired images for display on a monitor.

nodes.name: GammaEnable
nodes.description: Enables gamma correction.

nodes.name: GammaSelector
nodes.description: Sets the type of gamma to be applied.

nodes.name: GevCCP
nodes.description: Sets the control channel privilege.

nodes.name: GevCurrentDefaultGateway
nodes.description: Current default gateway of the selected network interface.

nodes.name: GevCurrentIPAddress
nodes.description: Current IP address of the selected network interface.

nodes.name: GevCurrentIPConfiguration
nodes.description: Current IP configuration of the selected network interface, e.g., fixed IP, DHCP, or auto IP.

nodes.name: GevCurrentSubnetMask
nodes.description: Current subnet mask of the selected network interface.

nodes.name: GevDeviceModeCharacterSet
nodes.description: Character set used by all strings of the bootstrap registers (1 = UTF8).

nodes.name: GevDeviceModeIsBigEndian
nodes.description: Indicates whether the bootstrap register is in big-endian format.

nodes.name: GevFirstURL
nodes.description: First URL reference to the GenICam XML file.

nodes.name: GevGVSPExtendedIDMode
nodes.description: Sets the Extended ID mode for GVSP (64-bit block ID, 32-bit packet ID). This bit can't be reset if the stream channels do not support the standard ID mode.

nodes.name: GevHeartbeatTimeout
nodes.description: Heartbeat timeout in milliseconds.

nodes.name: GevIEEE1588
nodes.description: Enables the IEEE 1588 V2 Precision Time Protocol for the timestamp register. Only available if the IEEE1588_support bit of the GVCP Capability register is set. When PTP is enabled, the Timestamp Control register can't be used to reset the timestamp. When PTP is enabled or disabled, the value of Timestamp Tick Frequency and Timestamp Value registers may change to reflect the new time domain.

nodes.name: GevIEEE1588ClockId
nodes.description: Latched IEEE 1588 clock ID of the camera. (The clock ID must first be latched using the IEEE 1588 Latch command.) The clock ID is an array of eight octets which is displayed as a hexadecimal number. Leading zeros are omitted.

nodes.name: GevIEEE1588ClockIdHigh
nodes.description: High part of the latched IEEE 1588 clock ID of the camera.

nodes.name: GevIEEE1588ClockIdLow
nodes.description: Low part of the latched IEEE 1588 clock ID of the camera.

nodes.name: GevIEEE1588DataSetLatch
nodes.description: Latches the current IEEE 1588-related values of the camera.

nodes.name: GevIEEE1588OffsetFromMaster
nodes.description: Latched offset from the IEEE 1588 master clock in nanoseconds. (The offset must first be latched using the IEEE 1588 Latch command.)

nodes.name: GevIEEE1588ParentClockId
nodes.description: Latched IEEE 1588 parent clock ID of the camera. (The parent clock ID must first be latched using the IEEE 1588 Latch command.) The parent clock ID is the clock ID of the current master clock. A clock ID is an array of eight octets which is displayed as a hexadecimal number. Leading zeros are omitted.

nodes.name: GevIEEE1588ParentClockIdHigh
nodes.description: High part of the latched IEEE 1588 parent clock ID of the camera.

nodes.name: GevIEEE1588ParentClockIdLow
nodes.description: Low part of the latched IEEE 1588 parent clock ID of the camera.

nodes.name: GevIEEE1588Status
nodes.description: Indicates the state of the IEEE 1588 clock. Values of this field must match the IEEE 1588 PTP port state enumeration (INITIALIZING, FAULTY, DISABLED, LISTENING, PRE_MASTER, MASTER, PASSIVE, UNCALIBRATED, SLAVE).

nodes.name: GevIEEE1588StatusLatched
nodes.description: Indicates the latched state of the IEEE 1588 clock. (The state must first be latched using the IEEE 1588 Latch command.) The state is indicated by values 1 to 9, corresponding to the states INITIALIZING, FAULTY, DISABLED, LISTENING, PRE_MASTER, MASTER, PASSIVE, UNCALIBRATED, and SLAVE.

nodes.name: GevInterfaceSelector
nodes.description: Sets the physical network interface to be configured. All changes to the network interface settings will be applied to the selected interface.

nodes.name: GevLinkCrossover
nodes.description: Indicates the state of medium-dependent interface crossover (MDIX) for the selected network interface.

nodes.name: GevLinkFullDuplex
nodes.description: Indicates whether the selected network interface operates in full-duplex mode.

nodes.name: GevLinkMaster
nodes.description: Indicates whether the selected network interface is the clock master.

nodes.name: GevLinkSpeed
nodes.description: Connection speed in Mbps of the selected network interface.

nodes.name: GevMACAddress
nodes.description: MAC address of the selected network interface.

nodes.name: GevMessageChannelCount
nodes.description: Number of message channels supported by the camera.

nodes.name: GevNumberOfInterfaces
nodes.description: Number of network interfaces of the camera.

nodes.name: GevPersistentDefaultGateway
nodes.description: Fixed default gateway of the selected network interface (if fixed IP addressing is supported by the camera and enabled).

nodes.name: GevPersistentIPAddress
nodes.description: Fixed IP address of the selected network interface (if fixed IP addressing is supported by the camera and enabled).

nodes.name: GevPersistentSubnetMask
nodes.description: Fixed subnet mask of the selected network interface (if fixed IP addressing is supported by the camera and enabled).

nodes.name: GevSCBWA
nodes.description: Base bandwidth in bytes per second that will be used by the camera to transmit image and chunk feature data and to handle resends and control data transmissions.

nodes.name: GevSCBWR
nodes.description: Percentage of the Ethernet bandwidth assigned to the camera to be held in reserve for packet resends and for the transmission of control data between the camera and the host computer. The setting is expressed as a percentage of the Bandwidth Assigned parameter. For example, if the Bandwidth Assigned parameter indicates that 30 MBytes/s have been assigned to the camera and the Bandwidth Reserve parameter is set to 5 %, the bandwidth reserve will be 1.5 MBytes/s.

nodes.name: GevSCBWRA
nodes.description: Multiplier for the Bandwidth Reserve parameter. The multiplier is used to establish an extra pool of reserved bandwidth that can be used if an unusually large burst of packet resends is needed.

nodes.name: GevSCDA
nodes.description: Destination address of the selected stream channel. The destination can be a unicast or a multicast address.

nodes.name: GevSCDCT
nodes.description: Actual bandwidth (in bytes per second) that the camera will use to transmit image data and chunk data with the current settings for AOI, chunk features, and pixel format.

nodes.name: GevSCDMT
nodes.description: Maximum amount of data (in bytes per second) that the camera can generate with its current settings under ideal conditions, i.e., unlimited bandwidth and no packet resends.

nodes.name: GevSCFJM
nodes.description: Maximum amount of time (in ticks) that the next frame transmission could be delayed due to a burst of resends. If the Bandwidth Reserve Accumulation parameter is set to a high value, the camera can experience periods where there is a large burst of data resends. This burst of resends will delay the start of transmission of the next acquired image.

nodes.name: GevSCFTD
nodes.description: Frame transmission delay on the selected stream channel (in ticks). This value sets a delay before transmitting the acquired image.

nodes.name: GevSCPD
nodes.description: Delay between the transmission of each packet on the selected stream channel. The delay is measured in ticks.

nodes.name: GevSCPHostPort
nodes.description: Destination port of the selected stream channel.

nodes.name: GevSCPInterfaceIndex
nodes.description: Index of the network interface to be used.

nodes.name: GevSCPSBigEndian
nodes.description: Indicates the endianness of multi-byte pixel data for this stream. True equals big-endian.

nodes.name: GevSCPSDoNotFragment
nodes.description: Disables IP fragmentation of packets on the stream channel. This bit is copied into the 'do not fragment' bit of the IP header of each stream packet.

nodes.name: GevSCPSFireTestPacket
nodes.description: Sends a GigE Vision streaming test packet. If this bit is set and the stream channel is a transmitter, the transmitter will send one test packet of the size specified by the Packet Size parameter. The 'do not fragment' bit of the IP header must be set for this test packet (see the SCPS Do Not Fragment parameter documentation).

nodes.name: GevSCPSPacketSize
nodes.description: Packet size in bytes on the selected stream channel. Excludes data leader and data trailer. (The last packet may be smaller because the packet size is not necessarily a multiple of the block size of the stream channel.)

nodes.name: GevSecondURL
nodes.description: Second URL reference to the GenICam XML file.

nodes.name: GevStreamChannelCount
nodes.description: Number of stream channels supported by the camera.

nodes.name: GevStreamChannelSelector
nodes.description: Sets the stream channels to be configured. All changes to the stream channel settings will be applied to the selected stream channel.

nodes.name: GevSupportedIEEE1588
nodes.description: Indicates whether the IEEE 1588 V2 Precision Time Protocol (PTP) is supported.

nodes.name: GevSupportedIPConfigurationDHCP
nodes.description: Indicates whether the selected network interface supports DHCP IP addressing.

nodes.name: GevSupportedIPConfigurationLLA
nodes.description: Indicates whether the selected network interface supports auto IP addressing (also known as LLA).

nodes.name: GevSupportedIPConfigurationPersistentIP
nodes.description: Indicates whether the selected network interface supports fixed IP addressing (also known as persistent IP addressing).

nodes.name: GevSupportedOptionalCommandsConcatenation
nodes.description: Indicates whether multiple operations in a single message are supported.

nodes.name: GevSupportedOptionalCommandsEVENT
nodes.description: Indicates whether EVENT_CMD and EVENT_ACK are supported.

nodes.name: GevSupportedOptionalCommandsEVENTDATA
nodes.description: Indicates whether EVENTDATA_CMD and EVENTDATA_ACK are supported.

nodes.name: GevSupportedOptionalCommandsPACKETRESEND
nodes.description: Indicates whether PACKETRESEND_CMD is supported.

nodes.name: GevSupportedOptionalCommandsWRITEMEM
nodes.description: Indicates whether WRITEMEM_CMD and WRITEMEM_ACK are supported.

nodes.name: GevSupportedOptionalLegacy16BitBlockID
nodes.description: Indicates whether this GVSP transmitter or receiver can support a 16-bit block ID.

nodes.name: GevTimestampControlLatch
nodes.description: Latches the current timestamp value of the camera.

nodes.name: GevTimestampControlLatchReset
nodes.description: Resets the timestamp control latch.

nodes.name: GevTimestampControlReset
nodes.description: Resets the timestamp value of the camera.

nodes.name: GevTimestampTickFrequency
nodes.description: Number of timestamp clock ticks in 1 second.

nodes.name: GevTimestampValue
nodes.description: Latched value of the timestamp. (The timestamp must first be latched using the Timestamp Control Latch command.)

nodes.name: GevVersionMajor
nodes.description: Major version number of the GigE Vision specification supported by this camera.

nodes.name: GevVersionMinor
nodes.description: Minor version number of the GigE Vision specification supported by this camera.

nodes.name: GrayValueAdjustmentDampingAbs
nodes.description: Gray value adjustment damping factor to be applied. This controls the speed with which pixel gray values are changed when Exposure Auto, Gain Auto, or both are enabled. This can be useful, for example, when objects move into the camera's field of view and the light conditions are changing gradually due to the moving objects.

nodes.name: GrayValueAdjustmentDampingRaw
nodes.description: Gray value adjustment damping factor (raw value) to be applied. This controls the speed with which pixel gray values are changed when Exposure Auto, Gain Auto, or both are enabled. This can be useful, for example, when objects move into the camera's field of view and the light conditions are changing gradually due to the moving objects.

nodes.name: Height
nodes.description: Height of the camera's region of interest (area of interest) in pixels. Depending on the camera model, the parameter can be set in different increments.

nodes.name: HeightMax
nodes.description: Maximum height of the region of interest (area of interest) in pixels. The value takes into account any features that may limit the maximum height, e.g., binning.

nodes.name: ImageFormat
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring the size of an acquired image and the format of the transferred pixel data.

nodes.name: ImageQualityControl
nodes.description: Contains parameters for optimizing the image quality.

nodes.name: LastError
nodes.description: Indicates the last error code in the memory. To delete the last error code from the list of error codes, use the Clear Last Error command.

nodes.name: LateActionEventData
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring Action Late events. An Action Late event is raised when a scheduled action command with a timestamp in the past is received.

nodes.name: LateActionEventStreamChannelIndex
nodes.display_name: Late Action Event Stream Channel Index
nodes.description: Stream channel index of the Action Late event. An Action Late event is raised when a scheduled action command with a timestamp in the past is received.

nodes.name: LateActionEventTimestamp
nodes.description: Timestamp of the Action Late event. An Action Late event is raised when a scheduled action command with a timestamp in the past is received.

nodes.name: LightSourceSelector
nodes.description: Sets the type of light source for which color transformation will be performed.

nodes.name: Line1RisingEdgeEventData
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring Line 1 Rising Edge events.

nodes.name: Line1RisingEdgeEventStreamChannelIndex
nodes.display_name: Line 1 Rising Edge Event Stream Channel Index
nodes.description: Stream channel index of the Line 1 Rising Edge event.

nodes.name: Line1RisingEdgeEventTimestamp
nodes.description: Timestamp of the Line 1 Rising Edge event.

nodes.name: Line2RisingEdgeEventData
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring Line 2 Rising Edge events.

nodes.name: Line2RisingEdgeEventStreamChannelIndex
nodes.display_name: Line 2 Rising Edge Event Stream Channel Index
nodes.description: Stream channel index of the Line 2 Rising Edge event.

nodes.name: Line2RisingEdgeEventTimestamp
nodes.description: Timestamp of the Line 2 Rising Edge event.

nodes.name: Line3RisingEdgeEventData
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring Line 3 Rising Edge events.

nodes.name: Line3RisingEdgeEventStreamChannelIndex
nodes.display_name: Line 3 Rising Edge Event Stream Channel Index
nodes.description: Stream channel index of the Line 3 Rising Edge event.

nodes.name: Line3RisingEdgeEventTimestamp
nodes.description: Timestamp of the Line 3 Rising Edge event.

nodes.name: Line4RisingEdgeEventData
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring Line 4 Rising Edge events.

nodes.name: Line4RisingEdgeEventStreamChannelIndex
nodes.display_name: Line 4 Rising Edge Event Stream Channel Index
nodes.description: Stream channel index of the Line 4 Rising Edge event.

nodes.name: Line4RisingEdgeEventTimestamp
nodes.description: Timestamp of the Line 4 Rising Edge event.

nodes.name: LineDebouncerTimeAbs
nodes.description: Line debouncer time in microseconds. The Line Debouncer allows you to filter out invalid hardware signals by specifying a minimum signal length.

nodes.name: LineDebouncerTimeRaw
nodes.description: Line debouncer time (raw value). The Line Debouncer allows you to filter out invalid hardware signals by specifying a minimum signal length.

nodes.name: LineFormat
nodes.description: Indicates the electrical configuration of the currently selected line.

nodes.name: LineInverter
nodes.description: Enables the signal inverter function for the currently selected input or output line.

nodes.name: LineLogic
nodes.description: Indicates the line logic of the currently selected line.

nodes.name: LineMode
nodes.description: Sets the mode for the selected line. This controls whether the physical line is used to input or output a signal.

nodes.name: LineSelector
nodes.description: Sets the I/O line to be configured. All changes to the line settings will be applied to the selected line.

nodes.name: LineSource
nodes.description: Sets the source signal for the currently selected line. The currently selected line must be an output line.

nodes.name: LineStartOvertriggerEventData
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring Line Start Overtrigger events.

nodes.name: LineStartOvertriggerEventStreamChannelIndex
nodes.display_name: Line Start Overtrigger Event Stream Channel Index
nodes.description: Stream channel index of the Line Start Overtrigger event.

nodes.name: LineStartOvertriggerEventTimestamp
nodes.description: Timestamp of the Line Start Overtrigger event.

nodes.name: LineStatus
nodes.description: Indicates the current logical state of the selected line.

nodes.name: LineStatusAll
nodes.description: Single bit field indicating the current logical state of all available line signals at time of polling.

nodes.name: LineTermination
nodes.description: Enables the termination resistor of the selected input line.

nodes.name: LUTControls
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring the operation of the camera's lookup table (LUT).

nodes.name: LUTEnable
nodes.description: Enables the selected lookup table (LUT).

nodes.name: LUTIndex
nodes.description: Pixel value to be replaced with the LUT Value pixel value.

nodes.name: LUTSelector
nodes.description: Sets the lookup table (LUT) to be configured. All changes to the LUT settings will be applied to the selected LUT.

nodes.name: LUTValue
nodes.description: New pixel value to replace the LUT Index pixel value.

nodes.name: LUTValueAll
nodes.description: A single register that lets you access all LUT entries. In many cases, this is faster than repeatedly changing individual entries in the LUT.

nodes.name: MinOutPulseWidthAbs
nodes.description: Minimum signal width of an output signal (in microseconds).

nodes.name: MinOutPulseWidthRaw
nodes.display_name: Line Output Pulse Min. Width Raw
nodes.description: Raw value of the minimum signal width of a signal that is received from the frequency converter or from the shaft encoder module and that is associated with a digital output line.

nodes.name: NoiseReductionAbs
nodes.description: Amount of noise reduction to be applied. The higher the value, the less chroma noise will be visible in your images. However, excessively high values may result in image information loss.

nodes.name: NoiseReductionRaw
nodes.description: Amount of noise reduction to be applied (raw value). The higher the value, the less chroma noise will be visible in your images. However, excessively high values may result in image information loss.

nodes.name: NumberOfActionSignals
nodes.description: Number of separate action signals supported by the camera. Determines how many action signals the camera can handle in parallel, i.e., how many different action commands can be configured on the camera.

nodes.name: OffsetX
nodes.description: Horizontal offset from the left side of the sensor to the region of interest (area of interest) (in pixels).

nodes.name: OffsetY
nodes.description: Vertical offset from the top of the sensor to the region of interest (area of interest) (in pixels).

nodes.name: OverTemperature
nodes.description: Indicates whether an over temperature state has been detected.

nodes.name: OverTemperatureEventData
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring Over Temperature events.

nodes.name: OverTemperatureEventStreamChannelIndex
nodes.display_name: Over Temperature Event Stream Channel Index
nodes.description: Stream channel index of the Over Temperature event.

nodes.name: OverTemperatureEventTimestamp
nodes.description: Timestamp of the Over Temperature event.

nodes.name: ParameterSelector
nodes.description: Sets the parameter whose factory limits can be removed. The factory limits can be removed using the Remove Limits parameter.

nodes.name: PayloadSize
nodes.description: Size of the payload in bytes. This is the total number of bytes sent in the payload.

nodes.name: PGIControl
nodes.description: Contains parameters related to the Basler PGI image optimization algorithm. The parameters in this category are only available if a non-Bayer pixel format, e.g., YCbCr or RGB, is used.

nodes.name: PgiMode
nodes.description: Enables Basler PGI image optimizations.

nodes.name: PixelColorFilter
nodes.description: Indicates the alignment of the camera's Bayer filter to the pixels in the acquired images.

nodes.name: PixelDynamicRangeMax
nodes.description: Maximum possible pixel value that can be transferred from the camera.

nodes.name: PixelDynamicRangeMin
nodes.description: Minimum possible pixel value that can be transferred from the camera.

nodes.name: PixelFormat
nodes.description: Sets the format of the pixel data transmitted by the camera. The available pixel formats depend on the camera model and whether the camera is monochrome or color.

nodes.name: PixelSize
nodes.description: Indicates the depth of the pixel values in the image (in bits per pixel). The potential values depend on the pixel format setting.

nodes.name: ReadoutTimeAbs
nodes.description: Sensor readout time with current settings.

nodes.name: RemoveLimits
nodes.description: Removes the factory-set limit of the selected parameter. If the factory limits are removed, a wider range of parameter values is available and only subect to technical restrictions. Choosing parameter values outside of the factory limits may affect image quality.

nodes.name: RemoveParamLimits
nodes.description: Contains parameters for removing the factory limits of camera parameters.

nodes.name: ResultingFramePeriodAbs
nodes.description: Maximum frame acquisition period with current camera settings (in microseconds).

nodes.name: ResultingFrameRateAbs
nodes.description: Maximum frame acquisition rate with current camera settings (in frames per second).

nodes.name: ReverseX
nodes.description: Enables horizontal mirroring of the image. The pixel values of every line in a captured image will be swapped along the line's center. You can use the ROI feature when using the Reverse X feature. The position of the ROI relative to the sensor remains the same.

nodes.name: ReverseY
nodes.description: Enables vertical mirroring of the image. The pixel values of every column in a captured image will be swapped along the column's center. You can use the ROI feature when using the Reverse Y feature. The position of the ROI relative to the sensor remains the same.

nodes.name: ROIZoneMode
nodes.description: Enables the output of color-improved raw image data. If enabled, color transformation and color adjustment will be applied to Bayer pixel formats.

nodes.name: ROIZoneOffset
nodes.description: Vertical offset of the currently selected ROI zone.

nodes.name: ROIZoneSelector
nodes.description: Sets the ROI zone that can be configured.

nodes.name: ROIZoneSize
nodes.description: Height of the currently selected ROI zone.

nodes.name: ScalingHorizontalAbs
nodes.description: Horizontal scaling factor.

nodes.name: ScalingVerticalAbs
nodes.description: Vertical scaling factor.

nodes.name: SensorHeight
nodes.description: Height of the camera's sensor in pixels.

nodes.name: SensorReadoutMode
nodes.description: Sets the sensor readout mode.

nodes.name: SensorWidth
nodes.description: Width of the camera's sensor in pixels.

nodes.name: SequenceAddressBitSelector
nodes.description: Sets which bit of the sequence set address can be assigned to an input line. An input line can be set as the control source for this bit using the Address Bit Source parameter.

nodes.name: SequenceAddressBitSource
nodes.description: Sets an input line as the control source for the currently selected sequence set address bit. The bit can be selected using the Address Bit Selector parameter.

nodes.name: SequenceAdvanceMode
nodes.description: Sets the sequence set advance mode.

nodes.name: SequenceAsyncAdvance
nodes.description: Enables asynchronous advance from one sequence set to the next. The advance is asynchronous to the camera's frame trigger. Only available in Controlled sequence advance mode.

nodes.name: SequenceAsyncRestart
nodes.description: Enables asynchronous restart of the sequence set sequence, starting with the sequence set that has the lowest index number. The restart is asynchronous to the camera's frame trigger. Only available in Auto and Controlled sequence advance mode.

nodes.name: SequenceConfigurationMode
nodes.description: Sets whether the sequencer can be configured.

nodes.name: SequenceControl
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring the sequencer. The sequencer allows you to quickly change parameter settings during image acquisition by storing the desired settings in a sequence set. During image acquisition, the sequencer then executes the sequence sets in the order specified by you.

nodes.name: SequenceControlConfiguration
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring the sequence set advance. You can choose whether to let the sequencer cycle through the sequence sets automatically, or whether you want to control the sequence via an input line or software commands.

nodes.name: SequenceControlSelector
nodes.description: Sets whether sequence advance or sequence restart can be configured. A control source must be chosen using the Sequence Control Source parameter.

nodes.name: SequenceControlSource
nodes.description: Sets the source for sequence control.

nodes.name: SequenceCurrentSet
nodes.description: Current sequence set.

nodes.name: SequenceEnable
nodes.description: Enables the sequencer.

nodes.name: SequenceSetExecutions
nodes.description: Number of consecutive executions per sequence cycle of the selected sequence set. Only available in Auto sequence advance mode.

nodes.name: SequenceSetIndex
nodes.description: This number uniquely identifies a sequence set.

nodes.name: SequenceSetLoad
nodes.description: Loads an existing sequence set to make it the current sequence set.

nodes.name: SequenceSetStore
nodes.description: Stores the current sequence set. Storing the current sequence set will overwrite any existing sequence set with the same index number. The sequence set is stored in the volatile memory and will therefore be lost if the camera is reset or if power is switched off.

nodes.name: SequenceSetTotalNumber
nodes.description: Total number of sequence sets in the sequence.

nodes.name: SharpnessEnhancementAbs
nodes.description: Sharpening value to be applied. The higher the sharpness, the more distinct the image subject's contours will be. However, excessively high values may result in image information loss.

nodes.name: SharpnessEnhancementRaw
nodes.description: Sharpening value to be applied (raw value). The higher the sharpness, the more distinct the image subject's contours will be. However, excessively high values may result in image information loss.

nodes.name: ShutterMode
nodes.description: Sets the shutter mode of the camera.

nodes.name: SyncFreeRunTimerEnable
nodes.description: Enables the synchronous free run mode. If enabled, the camera will generate all required frame start or line start trigger signals internally. You don't need to apply frame start or line start trigger signals to the camera.

nodes.name: SyncFreeRunTimerStartTimeHigh
nodes.display_name: Sync Free Run Start Time High
nodes.description: High 32 bits of the synchronous free run trigger start time.

nodes.name: SyncFreeRunTimerStartTimeLow
nodes.display_name: Sync Free Run Start Time Low
nodes.description: Low 32 bits of the synchronous free run trigger start time.

nodes.name: SyncFreeRunTimerTriggerRateAbs
nodes.description: Synchronous free run trigger rate.

nodes.name: SyncFreeRunTimerUpdate
nodes.description: Updates synchronous free run settings.

nodes.name: SyncUserOutputSelector
nodes.description: Sets the user-settable synchronous output signal to be configured.

nodes.name: SyncUserOutputValue
nodes.description: Enables the selected user-settable synchronous output line.

nodes.name: SyncUserOutputValueAll
nodes.description: Single bit field that sets the state of all user-settable synchronous output signals in one access.

nodes.name: TemperatureAbs
nodes.description: Temperature at the selected location in the camera (in degrees centigrade). The temperature is measured at the location specified by the Temperature Selector parameter.

nodes.name: TemperatureSelector
nodes.description: Sets the location in the camera where the temperature will be measured.

nodes.name: TemperatureState
nodes.description: Indicates the temperature state.

nodes.name: TestImageResetAndHold
nodes.description: Allows you to turn a moving test image into a fixed one. The test image will be displayed at its starting position and will stay fixed.

nodes.name: TestImageSelector
nodes.description: Sets the test image to display.

nodes.name: TimerControls
nodes.description: Contains parameters for configuring counters and timers.

nodes.name: TimerDelayAbs
nodes.description: Delay of the currently selected timer in microseconds.

nodes.name: TimerDelayRaw
nodes.description: Delay of the selected timer (raw value). This value will be used as a multiplier for the timer delay timebase. The actual delay time equals the current Timer Delay Raw value multiplied with the current Timer Delay Timebase value.

nodes.name: TimerDelayTimebaseAbs
nodes.description: Timebase (in microseconds) that is used when a timer delay is specified using the Timer Delay Raw parameter.

nodes.name: TimerDurationAbs
nodes.description: Duration of the currently selected timer in microseconds.

nodes.name: TimerDurationRaw
nodes.description: Duration of the selected timer (raw value). This value will be used as a multiplier for the timer duration timebase. The actual duration time equals the current Timer Duration Raw value multiplied with the current Timer Duration Timebase value.

nodes.name: TimerDurationTimebaseAbs
nodes.description: Timebase (in microseconds) that is used when a timer duration is specified using the Timer Duration Raw parameter.

nodes.name: TimerSelector
nodes.description: Sets the timer to be configured.

nodes.name: TimerTriggerActivation
nodes.description: Sets the type of signal transition that will start the timer.

nodes.name: TimerTriggerSource
nodes.description: Sets the internal camera signal used to trigger the selected timer.

nodes.name: TLParamsLocked
nodes.description: Indicates whether image acquisition is in progress.

nodes.name: TransportLayer
nodes.description: Contains parameters related to the GigE Vision transport layer.

nodes.name: TriggerActivation
nodes.description: Sets the type of signal transition that will activate the selected trigger.

nodes.name: TriggerDelayAbs
nodes.description: Trigger delay time in microseconds. The delay is applied after the trigger has been received and before effectively activating the trigger.

nodes.name: TriggerMode
nodes.description: Sets the mode for the currently selected trigger.

nodes.name: TriggerSelector
nodes.description: Sets the trigger type to be configured. All changes to the trigger settings will be applied to the selected trigger.

nodes.name: TriggerSoftware
nodes.description: Generates a software trigger signal. The software trigger signal will be used if the Trigger Source parameter is set to Trigger Software.

nodes.name: TriggerSource
nodes.description: Sets the source signal for the selected trigger.

nodes.name: UserDefinedValue
nodes.description: User-defined value. The value can serve as storage location for the camera user. It has no impact on the operation of the camera.

nodes.name: UserDefinedValues
nodes.description: Contains parameters for setting and getting user-defined values. The values serve as storage locations for the camera user and have no impact on the operation of the camera.

nodes.name: UserDefinedValueSelector
nodes.description: Sets the user-defined value to set or read.

nodes.name: UserOutputSelector
nodes.description: Sets the user-settable output signal to be configured. All changes to the user-settable output signal settings will be applied to the selected user-settable output signal.

nodes.name: UserOutputValue
nodes.description: Enables the selected user-settable output line.

nodes.name: UserOutputValueAll
nodes.description: Single bit field that sets the state of all user-settable output signals in one access.

nodes.name: UserSetDefaultSelector
nodes.description: Sets the user set or the factory set to be used as the startup set. The default startup set will be loaded as the active set whenever the camera is powered on or reset.

nodes.name: UserSetLoad
nodes.description: Loads the selected set into the camera's volatile memory and makes it the active configuration set. After the selected set has been loaded, the parameters in that set will control the camera.

nodes.name: UserSets
nodes.description: Contains parameters for creating user sets, also known as configuration sets. Groups of factory settings or user-defined settings can be saved in these sets and loaded again at a later stage or on a different camera.

nodes.name: UserSetSave
nodes.description: Saves the current active set as the selected user set.

nodes.name: UserSetSelector
nodes.description: Sets the user set or the factory set to load, save, or configure.

nodes.name: VignettingCorrectionControl
nodes.description: Contains parameters for performing vignetting correction.

nodes.name: VignettingCorrectionLoad
nodes.description: Loads the vignetting correction data into the camera.

nodes.name: VignettingCorrectionMode
nodes.description: The Vignetting Correction feature allows you to remove vignetting artifacts from your images. To do this, you first have to create vignetting correction data. For more information, see the Basler Product Documentation.

nodes.name: Width
nodes.description: Width of the camera's region of interest (area of interest) in pixels. Depending on the camera model, the parameter can be set in different increments.

nodes.name: WidthMax
nodes.description: Maximum width of the region of interest (area of interest) in pixels. The value takes into account any function that may limit the maximum width.
